failure_modes: Anchors dominate and suppress outsider ideas
gloss: Seed a search with people experienced in unrelated fields plus a few domain experts
invariants: Outsiders bring deep experience elsewhere, not inexperience
A small domain-expert core anchors the search
mechanism: Novelty in a problem comes from cross-domain analogy. A group composed of many experts from other fields (a musician, a doctor, a firefighter) plus a handful of domain experts generates interventions that a pure domain group or an inexperienced crowd cannot, because the outsiders bring transferable experience.
